notes: nanoid::nanoid!() with default features: 21 characters, default alphabet. The crate seeds a new StdRng from the OS on every call (StdRng::from_os_rng), so each ID includes a system call.
details: nanoid::nanoid!() with default features: 21 characters, default alphabet, rand-based generator. The crate seeds a new StdRng from the operating system on every call (StdRng::from_os_rng), so each ID includes a system call for entropy.
